member.name: M:CometEngine::RectTransform::ForceRefreshLayout()
member.summary: Resolves every layout still waiting to settle, including this one, instead of waiting for the layout pass that runs once per frame before rendering. Sizes and positions are safe to read as soon as it returns. Only reach for it when a resolved size is genuinely needed before the frame ends. Calling it after every item while filling a list is exactly the cost the once-per-frame pass exists to avoid. It settles nothing when it cannot do so safely, which is from inside a layout run or while the hierarchy is being recalculated. Both mean the call arrived from a reaction to geometry that is still being written, so read the sizes on the next frame there.

member.summary: Makes a content group's assets available. LOCAL groups ship inside the game's base content, so they are always available and this is a no-op for them (as it is in the editor). A REMOTE group first checks its tiny .manifest on the CDN (once per session): when the pack changed since it was cached, the new one is downloaded — so updating remote content is just uploading the new .ori + .manifest pair, with no game update. Downloads are resumable and checksum-verified; when the CDN is unreachable the cached pack keeps working offline. Poll IsGroupReady (or GetGroupDownloadedBytes) for completion.
member.param: The content group name.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Assets::ReleaseGroup(string)
member.summary: Releases a REMOTE content group so its downloaded pack can unmount once none of its assets are loaded (the cached file stays, so ensuring it again does not re-download). LOCAL groups ship inside the base content and cannot be released.
member.param: The content group name.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Assets::IsGroupReady(string)
member.summary: Checks if a content group's assets are available to load. LOCAL groups are always ready; a REMOTE group is ready once its downloaded pack is mounted.
member.param: The content group name.
member.returns: True if the group is ready.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Assets::GetGroupDownloadSize(string)
member.summary: Gets the total download size in bytes of a REMOTE content group (0 for LOCAL groups or when it is already cached).
member.param: The content group name.
member.returns: The download size in bytes.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Assets::GetGroupDownloadedBytes(string)
member.summary: Gets the bytes downloaded so far for a REMOTE content group being ensured.
member.param: The content group name.
member.returns: The downloaded bytes.

member.summary: Sets the current cursor.

The hotspot of the cursor, in pixels. The hotspot is the point within the cursor that will be used for clicking. (0,0) is the top-left corner of the texture.

member.name: P:CometEngine::Texture2D::isReadable
member.summary: Returns true when the pixels can really be read or written right now. Unlike arePixelsEditable, which only reports the import setting, this also checks that the pixels are actually in memory: a texture whose sprites are all packed into a Sprite Atlas is never loaded, so it has no pixels even though Modify Pixels is enabled. Always check this before GetPixels/SetPixels.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Texture2D::IsReadyToUse()
member.summary: Returns true if the texture is completly loaded. While the texture is still loading or not loaded it returns false. Useful to know when the pixels of a read/write texture can be edited.

member.summary: Waits until the texture finishes loading. If the texture is not currently being loaded it returns immediately.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Texture2D::SetPixelAtDeferred(Color,uint,uint)
member.summary: Same as SetPixelAt but does not upload anything: the change is only recorded until Apply() is called. Use it to edit many pixels and then upload the whole touched region in one go.

X coordinate of the pixel
Y coordinate of the pixel

member.name: M:CometEngine::Texture2D::Apply()
member.summary: Uploads every pixel change recorded by SetPixelAtDeferred. The upload covers only the region that was actually touched, and it also reaches the Sprite Atlas pages this texture's sprites were packed into, so the change is visible on whatever image is being rendered.

member.summary: The wet/dry mix of the effect, from 0.0 (only the original dry signal) to 1.0 (only the processed signal).

member.summary: Delay of the echo sound in milliseconds

member.summary: Percentage of output fed back into input

member.summary: An audio flange effect. It creates a whooshing or sweeping sound by mixing two identical signals together, with one signal delayed by a small and gradually changing period.

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectFlange::wetMix
member.summary: The wet/dry mix of the effect, from 0.0 (only the original dry signal) to 1.0 (only the processed signal).

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectFlange::depth
member.summary: Percentage by which the delay time is modulated by the low-frequency oscillator, in hundredths of a percentage point

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectFlange::speed
member.summary: Rate of the low-frequency oscillator that sweeps the delay time, in Hz.

member.name: T:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb
member.summary: An audio reverb effect. It simulates the reverberation of sound in a physical space.

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb::wetMix
member.summary: The wet/dry mix of the effect, from 0.0 (only the original dry signal) to 1.0 (only the processed signal).

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb::freeze
member.summary: When driven towards 1.0 it freezes the reverb tank, sustaining the current reverberation indefinitely.

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb::roomSize
member.summary: Size of the simulated room. Larger values produce a longer, more spacious reverb tail. Range 0.0 to 1.0.

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb::damp
member.summary: High-frequency damping of the reverb tail. Higher values absorb high frequencies faster, making the reverb darker. Range 0.0 to 1.0.

member.name: P:CometEngine::AudioEffectReverb::width
member.summary: Stereo width of the reverb output, from 0.0 (mono) to 1.0 (full stereo).

member.name: T:CometEngine::MultiplayerSpawner
member.summary: Spawns InstanciableEntity instances across the network. The authority of the spawner's entity creates an instance with Spawn() and every remote peer receives a replicated copy with a matching network id. Configure the spawnable InstanciableEntity list in the editor (drag InstanciableEntities onto the inspector).

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSpawner::Spawn(int)
member.summary: Authority-only: instantiates the spawnable InstanciableEntity at the given index and replicates it to peers.
member.param: Index into the spawner's spawnable InstanciableEntity list.
member.returns: The spawned instance, or null if not the authority / index invalid / over the limit.

member.name: P:CometEngine::MultiplayerSpawner::spawnLimit
member.summary: Maximum number of instances this spawner may create (0 = unlimited).

member.name: T:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer
member.summary: Replicates the configured fields of its entity from the authority to remote peers. Configure the replicated fields in the editor, or call AddTransformPreset() from script.

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::AddTransformPreset()
member.summary: Adds position, rotation and scale of the entity's transform to the replicated set (ALWAYS mode).

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::ClearReplication()
member.summary: Removes every replicated field from this synchronizer.

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::SetVisibilityFor(int,bool)
member.summary: Sets whether this synchronizer replicates to a given peer (per-peer interest management). Only meaningful once the synchronizer is made non-public via SetVisibilityPublic(false).

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::GetVisibilityFor(int)
member.summary: Returns whether the given peer is currently in this synchronizer's visible set.

member.name: M:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::SetVisibilityPublic(bool)
member.summary: Sets whether this synchronizer is visible to all peers (true, the default) or only to the peers added with SetVisibilityFor (false).

member.name: P:CometEngine::MultiplayerSynchronizer::interpolate
member.summary: When true, remote copies ease their numeric fields (position, rotation, scale, ...) toward the received values instead of snapping. Disabled by default; the authority is unaffected.

member.name: T:CometEngine::Network::Crypto
member.summary: mbedTLS-backed crypto primitives. Provides secure random bytes, RSA key generation, self-signed certificate generation, signing/verification, public-key encryption/decryption and one-shot HMAC. Binary data is passed as raw byte strings. hashType selects the digest algorithm (0 = SHA1, 1 = SHA256, 2 = SHA512).

member.name: T:CometEngine::Network::HTTPClient
member.summary: HTTP/1.1 client. Use ConnectToHost() then Poll() until GetStatus() is HTTP_STATUS_CONNECTED, call Request(), keep polling until HasResponse(), then drain the body with ReadResponseBodyChunk(). The backend is chosen automatically: TCP/TLS on desktop/mobile, browser fetch on web. method is an HTTPClientMethod (HTTP_METHOD_GET, HTTP_METHOD_POST, ...); GetStatus() returns an HTTPClientStatus (HTTP_STATUS_CONNECTED, HTTP_STATUS_BODY, ...). GetResponseCode() returns the raw HTTP status code (e.g. 200 = OK, 404 = not found).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::GetConnectionState()
member.summary: Connection state: 0 = new, 1 = connecting, 2 = connected, 3 = disconnected, 4 = failed, 5 = closed.
member.returns: The WebRTCConnectionState describing the connection's current state.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::GetGatheringState()
member.summary: ICE gathering state: 0 = new, 1 = gathering, 2 = complete.
member.returns: The WebRTCGatheringState describing the ICE gathering progress.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::GetSignalingState()
member.summary: Signaling state: 0 = stable, 1 = have-local-offer, 2 = have-remote-offer, 3 = have-local-pranswer, 4 = have-remote-pranswer, 5 = closed.
member.returns: The WebRTCSignalingState describing the offer/answer negotiation state.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::Initialize()
member.summary: Initializes the connection.
member.returns: True if initialization succeeded (NetError OK), false otherwise.

member.param: The label identifying the data channel.
Whether the channel delivers messages in order.
Whether the channel is negotiated out-of-band rather than in-band.
The channel id to use when negotiated, or -1 to assign automatically.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::CreateOffer()
member.summary: Generates an SDP offer.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Network::WebRTCPeerConnection::SetRemoteDescription(string,string)

member.summary: RFC 6455 WebSocket peer exchanging complete messages as packets. The backend is selected at runtime: native builds use a wslay client/server, web builds use the browser (client only). Connect with ConnectToUrl (ws:// or wss://) then Poll until GetReadyState() returns 1 (open).

member.name: T:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer
member.summary: A block of native memory. Use it to build the struct and out-parameter buffers native calls read and write — get its address with GetAddress() to pass as a 'ptr' argument, then read the fields back by offset after the call. All reads and writes are bounds-checked against the buffer size; the address is stable until Resize reallocates the buffer.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::GetAddress()
member.summary: The raw address of the buffer's first byte, to pass as a native pointer argument (0 when empty).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Resize(uint)
member.summary: Reallocates the buffer to a new size, zero-filled. Invalidates the previous address.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Int8(uint)
member.summary: Reads a signed 8-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Int16(uint)
member.summary: Reads a signed 16-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Int32(uint)
member.summary: Reads a signed 32-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Int64(uint)
member.summary: Reads a signed 64-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Float(uint)
member.summary: Reads a 32-bit float at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::Ptr(uint)
member.summary: Reads a pointer-sized value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::CString(uint)
member.summary: Reads a null-terminated UTF-8 C string starting at the offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::WriteInt8(uint,int)
member.summary: Writes a signed 8-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::WriteInt32(uint,int)
member.summary: Writes a signed 32-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::WriteInt64(uint,int64)
member.summary: Writes a signed 64-bit value at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::WriteFloat(uint,float)
member.summary: Writes a 32-bit float at the byte offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::WritePtr(uint,uint64)
member.summary: Writes a pointer-sized value at the byte offset.

member.name: P:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::}
member.summary: Copies a byte string into the buffer starting at the offset.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::NativeBuffer::Create(uint)
member.summary: Allocates a zero-filled native buffer of the given size in bytes.

member.name: P:CometEngine::Native::NativeBuffer::NativeBuffer::}
member.summary: Allocates a native buffer initialized from a byte string.

member.name: T:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall
member.summary: The argument stack for a single native call. Push the arguments in the exact order and class the function's signature declares — every Push returns this same object so the calls can be chained — then finish with the Invoke* method matching the return type. The pushed argument count must match the signature or the call is rejected (and returns a zero value).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::Int(int)
member.summary: Pushes a signed 32-bit integer argument.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::Int64(int64)
member.summary: Pushes a signed 64-bit integer argument.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::Bool(bool)
member.summary: Pushes a boolean argument (marshalled as a 1-byte value).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::Double(double)
member.summary: Pushes a 64-bit double argument (only valid in an early argument slot).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::Str(string)
member.summary: Pushes a string argument, marshalled as a UTF-8 const char* valid for the duration of the call.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::InvokeVoid()
member.summary: Invokes the function ignoring any return value.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::InvokeInt()
member.summary: Invokes the function and returns its signed 32-bit result.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::InvokeInt64()
member.summary: Invokes the function and returns its signed 64-bit result.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::InvokePtr()
member.summary: Invokes the function and returns its pointer result as a raw address (a uint64).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeCall::InvokeDouble()
member.summary: Invokes the function and returns its 64-bit double result.

member.name: T:CometEngine::Native::NativeFunction
member.summary: A native function resolved from a NativeLibrary, bound to a call signature. Begin a call with Call(), push the arguments in order on the returned NativeCall, then invoke it with the finisher matching the return type.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeFunction::IsValid()
member.summary: Whether the function resolved and its signature parsed. Check GetError() when false.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeFunction::GetError()
member.summary: The reason the function is not valid, or empty when it is.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeFunction::Call()
member.summary: Begins a call: returns a fresh NativeCall argument stack for this function. Push the arguments on it in order, then invoke it. Returns null only when the function is invalid.

member.name: T:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary
member.summary: A loaded native dynamic library (.dll / .so / .dylib). Load it by logical name — no prefix or extension. At build it resolves against the plugins shipped next to the executable (Plugins/<arch>/, Plugins/ and the executable folder). It then falls back to the operating-system search path. A full path or a name with an extension is loaded as given.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::IsLoaded()
member.summary: Whether the library loaded successfully. Check GetError() when false.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::GetPath()
member.summary: The resolved file path the library was loaded from (empty when it failed to load).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::GetError()
member.summary: The reason the library failed to load, or empty when it loaded.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::GetSymbol(string)
member.summary: Resolves an exported symbol to its raw address, or 0 when it is missing.
member.param: The exact exported symbol name.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::GetFunction(string,string)
member.summary: Resolves an exported function ready to be called. The signature describes the C prototype as "ret(arg, arg, ...)" using the tokens: void, bool, int, uint, int64, uint64, float, double, ptr, str. 'ptr' passes a raw address (a uint64), 'str' marshals a string as a UTF-8 const char*. Returns a NativeFunction that is invalid (IsValid() == false) when the symbol is missing or the signature is bad.
member.param: The exported function symbol name.
The call signature, e.g. "bool(ptr,str)".
member.returns: The resolved function wrapper (never null).

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::Unload()
member.summary: Frees the OS module handle. Every function resolved from this library becomes unusable.

member.name: M:CometEngine::Native::NativeLibrary::NativeLibrary::Load(string)
member.summary: Loads a native library by logical name or path. Never returns null: check IsLoaded()/GetError() on the result.
member.param: The logical library name (no prefix/extension) or an explicit file name/path.
member.returns: The library wrapper.

member.summary: Absolute character index within the full text string.

member.summary: Positional offset relative to the character's normal rendered position.

member.summary: Color of the character. Modify to tint or override.

member.name: F:CometEngine::UI::BBCodeHandlerData::paramsRaw
member.summary: Raw parameters string declared in the tag, in "key=value" space-separated format. E.g. for [my_effect spread=0.5 tint=#FF0000] this is "spread=0.5 tint=#FF0000". Use GetFloat / GetString / HasParam for convenient access.

member.name: M:CometEngine::UI::BBCodeHandlerData::GetFloat(string,double)
member.summary: Returns the value of a tag parameter as a double.
member.param: The parameter name to look up (e.g. "spread").
Value returned when the key is not present. Defaults to 0.0.
member.returns: The parameter value parsed as a double, or defaultVal if not found.

member.name: M:CometEngine::UI::BBCodeHandlerData::GetString(string,string)
member.summary: Returns the value of a tag parameter as a string.
member.param: The parameter name to look up (e.g. "tint").
Value returned when the key is not present. Defaults to an empty string.
member.returns: The raw parameter value as a string, or defaultVal if not found.

member.name: M:CometEngine::UI::BBCodeHandlerData::GetInt(string,int64)
member.summary: Returns the value of a tag parameter as an integer.
member.param: The parameter name to look up (e.g. "count").
Value returned when the key is not present. Defaults to 0.
member.returns: The parameter value parsed as an int64, or defaultVal if not found.

member.name: M:CometEngine::UI::BBCodeHandlerData::HasParam(string)
member.summary: Returns whether a parameter key exists in the tag.
member.param: The parameter name to check (e.g. "bold").
member.returns: True if the key was declared in the tag, false otherwise.
